subject: Mathematics
topic: College Algebra & Trigonometry: Polynomial and Rational Functions
reasoning: Nasankha phunziro ili chifukwa tikukonzekera mayeso a pa November 9, 2026, ndipo Ntchito za Polynomial ndi Rational zili m'ndandanda wofunikira wa chaka choyamba ku koleji.

elements.text: Lero tiyamba phunziro latsopano la Polynomial ndi Rational Functions.

segments.speech: Moni bwanji Roosevelt! M'mawa watsopano uwu ndi wabwino kwambiri kuti tiyambe phunziro lathu latsopano la m'buku la College Algebra ndi Trigonometry. Popeza mayeso athu ali pafupi, tiyeni tione ntchito za polynomial ndi rational functions mwatsatanetsatane. Kodi muli okonzeka?

elements.text: Polynomial ndi nambala kapena kusakaniza kwa nambala ndi ma variable (monga x) okhala ndi mphamvu (exponents) zabwino zokha.

segments.speech: Tiyeni tiyambe ndi funso lakuti: kodi polynomial nchiyani? Ganizirani za kapangidwe kake ngati nyumba yomangidwa ndi njerwa za x ndi manambala ake. Mphamvu zake ziyenera kukhala zowongoka kapena zabwino, osati zolakwika. Kodi zimveka bwino mpaka pano?

elements.text: M'chitsanzo ichi, mphamvu za x ndi 2 ndi 1, zomwe ndi zabwino. Nambala 3 ndi 2 ndi coefficients.
Mphamvu siyenera kukhala yolakwika monga -1 kapena mizu!

segments.speech: Tiyeni tiwone chitsanzo cha polynomial. P(x) = 3x lalikulu kuphatikiza 2x kuchotseratu 5. Kodi mwamvetsa chifukwa chake ichi ndi polynomial, Roosevelt?

elements.text: Q(x) = √x + 1 sichonso polynomial chifukwa mizu ya x siyingakhale ndi mphamvu ya fractional.

segments.speech: Tiyeni tiwone chitsanzo cha zomwe siziri polynomial. Ngati tili ndi P(x) yofanana ndi 2x wamphamvu ya -1, iyi si polynomial chifukwa mphamvu yake ndi yolakwika, si nambala yabwino. Kodi mwamvetsa chifukwa chake?
